title: Introduce yourself
context: You meet a Chinese classmate on your first day of class.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 你好！我叫李明。你叫什么名字？
turns.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào lǐ míng. nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ! ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄇㄧㄥˊ. ㄋㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄕㄣˊㄇㄜ˙ ㄇㄧㄥˊㄗ˙?
turns.translation: Hi! My name is Li Ming. What's your name?
turns.text: 你好！我叫李明。你叫什么名字？
turns.romanization: nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào lǐ míng. nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
turns.translation_en: Hi! My name is Li Ming. What's your name?
turns.translation_id: Halo! Nama saya Li Ming. Siapa namamu?

choices.feedback: Perfect: you greet and respond with 我叫 + name.
That answers 你好吗, not the question about your name.
Ending the conversation here would cut it short.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 很高兴认识你！你是哪国人？
turns.pinyin: hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ! nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄣˇ ㄍㄠㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄖㄣˋㄕ˙ ㄋㄧˇ! ㄋㄧˇ ㄕˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄍㄨㄛˊ ㄖㄣˊ?
turns.translation: Nice to meet you! What country are you from?
turns.text: 很高兴认识你！你是哪国人？
turns.romanization: hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ! nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
turns.translation_en: Nice to meet you! What country are you from?
turns.translation_id: Senang berkenalan! Kamu dari negara mana?

choices.feedback: Grammatically correct, but not a credible answer.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 太好了！我们一起学习吧。
turns.pinyin: tài hǎo le! wǒmen yìqǐ xuéxí ba.
turns.zhuyin: ㄊㄞˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄌㄜ˙! ㄨㄛˇㄇㄣ˙ ㄧˋㄑㄧˇ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄒㄧˊ ㄅㄚ˙.
turns.text: 太好了！我们一起学习吧。
turns.romanization: tài hǎo le! wǒmen yìqǐ xuéxí ba.

context_en: You meet a Chinese classmate on your first day of class.
context_id: Kamu bertemu teman sekelas asal Tiongkok di hari pertama.

title: Ordering food
context: You enter a small restaurant in Beijing at meal time.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: huānyíng! ní yáo shénme?
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄨㄢㄧㄥˊ! ㄋㄧˊ ㄧㄠˊ ㄕㄣˊㄇㄜ˙?

choices.feedback: Perfect: 我要 + what you order.
是 identifies, which doesn't work for ordering. Use 我要.
Word order is inverted: you would instead say you would like the rice.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: hǎo de. yào hē shuǐ ma?
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄉㄜ˙. ㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄜ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄇㄚ˙?
turns.romanization: hǎo de. yào hē shuǐ ma?

choices.pinyin: búyòng, xièxie. yǒu chá jiù hǎo.
choices.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˊㄩㄥˋ, ㄒㄧㄝˋㄒㄧㄝ˙. ㄧㄡˇ ㄔㄚˊ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄠˇ.
choices.translation: No need, thanks. Tea will do.

choices.feedback: Valid, but doesn't answer the waiter's question.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: hǎo, qǐng děng yíxià.
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ, ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄥˇ ㄧˊㄒㄧㄚˋ.

context_en: You enter a small restaurant in Beijing at meal time.

title: Buying at the market
context: You want to buy fruit at a market stall.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! yào mǎi shénme?
turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ! ㄧㄠˋ ㄇㄞˇ ㄕㄣˊㄇㄜ˙?
turns.translation: Hello! What would you like to buy?
turns.translation_en: Hello! What would you like to buy?

choices.feedback: The key question for any purchase.
Careful! Ask about the object: 这个多少钱.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: bā kuài qián. hěn hǎochī!
turns.zhuyin: ㄅㄚ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ. ㄏㄣˇ ㄏㄠˇㄔ!

choices.feedback: Remember: 两, not 二, before a measure word.
Almost: before a measure word use 两, not 二.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: shíliù kuài. xièxie!
turns.zhuyin: ㄕˊㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄎㄨㄞˋ. ㄒㄧㄝˋㄒㄧㄝ˙!

context_en: You want to buy fruit at a market stall.
context_id: Kamu ingin membeli buah di kios pasar.
